occurrences.key: The combined code exposed an additional seam: the landed pending-closure reconciler required a Git landing head, which a verification-only record intentionally lacks. Its additive verification branch now resolves the retained unchanged commit/tree and observes all associated tracker statuses through `sourceVerified`; it never manufactures a landing or increments merge counts. Unavailable, mismatched or contradictory facts hold recovery even when a later tracker response claims closure. Verification closure now appends its clear and typed completion with structured `appended: true` confirmation before reducing the obligation or settling completed; failed writes retain the accepted basis and hold recovery. Cleanup observations preserve additive existing Recovery fields and evidence. Existing implementation landing reconciliation and regression classification remain intact.
